scope: Allocated-CPU checkpoint writer preserving raw, stored and decompressed hashes.

contract.lift_success: Every observed phase in [0.52,0.60) has egg height >= initial height + 0.05 m and nonzero (>1e-12 N) contacts with both finger links, counted at crossing 0.60.
contract.descent: Height decreases by more than 0.001 m over one dt=0.01 step in the named controller window.
contract.tail: Per-environment recorded fit evaluations, sample counts, integration retries and elastic work. These are parallel work proxies, not individual GPU wall times.
contract.timing: Both device collection kernels and the public position getter are inside each rollout step. Boundary exports are outside repeat timing.

limitations: Clean coalesced-position/valid-source/warm-Hessian/sparse-diagnostic combination, exact source snapshots and patches retained. Low-shell FP64/Q10/s8/max output, B16384/623102 with600 warmup and one complete1280-step varied trajectory. Includes35-case CPU qualification with unchanged final wrench/full residual/stress budgets. Fences and exports perturb scheduling; these are serialized diagnostic latencies. Nested fan wrapper/chart/sample calls overlap. Work/field exports occur outside measured kernel latency. Complete environment metrics, tails and buffer accounting are retained. Independent CPU assembles the same mesh stiffness, gauge/factor and checks every captured field's complete residual/tensor/von Mises/global peak. Balanced RHS does not independently reconstruct dynamic fitting/relief; separate original-wrench/relief capture and fixture oracles cover those paths. Final-source matched wider/copied scopes and plateau are separate requirements. No individual environment wall-time attribution, physical convergence or full RL training claim.
